messages:
Sam: Quick sync - aiming to publish the product launch blog Thu 10am PT. Need owners for hero tagline, bench stat wording + 2-line methodology, production UI screenshot, top-of-post webinar signup (prefill email), HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, and legal quick pass. Who can take which? :calendar:

Lina: I9ll take hero + bench phrasing. Will avoid absolutes and add a short methodology note. Two hero options later today.

Omar: I9ll grab the staging screenshot and export hero crops (1200x630 + retina). Ping me the demo route.

Priya: I9ll create the HubSpot form, add hidden fields `lead_source=blog`, `product_interest=inference`, `orig_utm`, and support `email` prefill param. Will also wire UTMs for cta_a/cta_b.

DesignBot: Assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marketing/announce_hero_candidates.png. Recommend hero export 1200x630.

Eve (Legal): On bench wording: change "cuts inference cost 60%" -> "internal tests show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost" and add a one-line methodology parenthetical. Also avoid "enterprise-grade"; prefer "enterprise-ready."

Lina: Noted. Drafted bench line and method: "Internal tests on mixed-length prompts show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost (10k requests, 8xA100 baseline, end-to-end)." Pushed to /content/drafts/announce_blog.md.

Omar: Screenshot captured from `console.redwood.com/demo?view=publish`. Crops exported and scrubbed of real org names. Uploaded to drive.

Priya: UTMs set: `utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=announce_q2&utm_content={cta_variant}`. Registration link supports `?email=` prefill. Also added SFDC routing: company_size>=500 -> AE Enterprise.

Eve (Legal): Reviewing latest draft. One small nit: replace "industry-leading" -> "industry-proven" or remove.

Lina: Removed the qualifier and pushed final copy.

Sam: Final checklist - react :white_check_mark: when done: hero locked, bench caveat, screenshot uploaded, assets optimized, HubSpot + hidden fields, UTMs, legal sign-off.

Lina: Hero + bench caveat done. :white_check_mark:

Omar: Screenshot + exports done. :white_check_mark:

DesignBot: Assets optimized and webp generated. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot + hidden fields + UTMs wired, prefill tested, SFDC mapping added. :white_check_mark:

Eve (Legal): Final sign-off. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Thanks team - scheduling publish Thu 10am PT. :tada:
